text:
Where do I even begin? This was the most incredible experience with the most professional company I’ve ever encountered. From start to finish, everything was seamless. Quick communication and incredibly helpful staff made the process so easy – I even booked the day before via chat! It was no problem for them. They arranged a private driver to pick me up, and I was greeted with a brand-new car that smelled great and a driver who was courteous and professional.

Upon arrival, I was asked to wait briefly, signed my waiver, and then got suited up with a helmet. Although the staff didn’t speak much English, Google Translate bridged the gap effortlessly. From the very first step, I felt completely safe and well-cared for. They even provided water and a stunning sunset view while I waited for my turn.

When my time came, they strapped me in, handed me a GoPro, and off we went. The view was breathtaking – like stepping into a painting. Words can’t describe the feeling of being up there; you have to experience it yourself. The pilot was professional, ensuring a safe and smooth ride both up and down.

I highly recommend the 30-minute sunset flight – it’s truly magical. I left with the biggest smile and wished I could give them more stars than Google allows. Truly unforgettable!

restaurant_name: BLUE SKY : PARAMOTOR CHIANGMAI พารามอเตอร์ เชียงใหม่
text:
This is a powered paragliding experience in Chiang Mai, offering breathtaking aerial views of fields, mountains, and countryside. The feeling of flying is both thrilling and liberating, making it a truly unique and unforgettable experience.

Highlights
• The powered paragliding experience is truly unique, allowing you to genuinely feel the sensation of "flying."
• Takeoff and landing are handled by professional instructors, making it suitable even for beginners.
• Wide-open views of the surrounding natural scenery of Chiang Mai.
• A smooth yet exhilarating flight experience.

Pricing
• Flight price: 3000 THB/person
• Photo + video service: 2500 THB (1-2 people)

Important Notes
• Advance booking is recommended, as flight times are subject to weather conditions.
• Wear comfortable clothing and closed shoes.
• Those with a fear of heights or health conditions should participate with caution.

Overall Review
This is a highly recommended high-altitude experience. While not inexpensive, the flight perspective and overall experience are exceptional. If you want to add a true aerial adventure to your Chiang Mai trip, this is a worthwhile option.

text:
A free shuttle picked us up from our accommodation, and the journey was quick. I wore my flight suit because I'm terrified of heights, so I was a little worried during takeoff, but I thought, "Okay, I'm here, let's do it!" 😄

When my feet were in the air, I almost cried; it was so beautiful! The feeling was amazing, the wind on my face was cool and refreshing. The landing was smooth and not scary at all. I highly recommend it to anyone who's easily scared like me – you'll love it! Thank you to Ann and Benz for showing me how to use the camera and taking such amazing photos. My friend even asked if we should come again next month! 5555
